additional_info.subject: RE: ID0406791-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / RN 170002846] The charging station is offline, CRM:00641001083
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well,
Regarding this case, the charger is not online on SCB, which prevents us from performing any remote troubleshooting. Therefore, we request you to schedule a site intervention and inform us at least one day in advance so that a team member can be available for assistance.
Possible Causes and Recommended Actions:
Network Issues (Siemens Router)
The failover function may have switched the WAN from Cellular to Ethernet.
If the charger is connected to the OCPP server, a hard reset from OCPP or a local reboot may bring it back online.
Mobile Network Issues
SIM card may be disabled or expired.
Monthly data volume might be exhausted.
Signal strength could have weakened due to radio transmission conditions.
M2M contract might not have IP enabled.
Backend-Related Issues
Backend settings for the charger may have changed.
OCPP server on the backend may be unavailable.
Teltonika Router Issues
Router may have switched to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Possible hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
Action Required:
Please carry a spare router, SIM card, and an Ethernet cable in case a replacement is needed during the site visit.
